# ND-120, version L (nd120-dly)

`nd120-dly` is the [ND-120](nd120.md) token table with 3 tokens replaced. The replacements are the block `variant_overrides` / `nd120-dly` at the end of [`defs/tokens/nd120-tokens.yaml`](https://github.com/RetroCoreLabs/nd-microcode-meta/blob/main/defs/tokens/nd120-tokens.yaml). Every other token, and the fields, are those of the ND-120.

| Token | nd120 (version K) | nd120-dly (version L) | Description (version L) |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `B,P` | `004002` (w2, bits 31-16) | `000002` (w2, bits 31-16) | B-OP. IS 2. USED TO ADDR. THE P-REGISTER (L: no DLY1) |
| `B,B` | `004003` (w2, bits 31-16) | `000003` (w2, bits 31-16) | B-OP. IS 3. USED TO ADDR. THE B-REGISTER (L: no DLY1) |
| `B,X` | `004007` (w2, bits 31-16) | `000007` (w2, bits 31-16) | B-OP. IS 7. USED TO ADDR. THE X-REGISTER (L: no DLY1) |

Every mnemonic is listed on the [extension site](https://retrocorelabs.github.io/nd-microcode/docs/variants/nd120-dly/).
